title: COSIS Overlay: Adapting and Using Generative SI – Assistant / Large Language Model (LLM)
primary_risks: Direct and indirect prompt injection via untrusted retrieved context or tool descriptions
Sensitive PII or secret exfiltration through model context windows and generated outputs
Unbounded token/payload consumption exhausting inference budgets or overflowing context
Ungrounded hallucinated outputs feeding operational or compliance decisions of record

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Enforce tenant and classification boundaries between RAG retrieval stores, prompt context assembly, and model output channels so cross-tenant documents never enter shared context.

parameter_assignments.ac-04_odp.01: per-request stateless context isolation with explicit tenant filter predicates and zero shared global prompt caches

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Verify concurrent generative requests cannot read prior caller context or cross-tenant RAG chunks.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Validate structured inputs, retrieved schemas, and metadata descriptions; strip or reject imperative prompt-injection directives embedded in external schemas and docstrings.

parameter_assignments.si-10_odp.01: JSON Schema 2020-12 strict validation plus AST/text scan blocking imperative prompt-injection directives

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Confirm untrusted inputs and tool/RAG metadata undergo deterministic schema and prompt-hygiene validation.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Bound prompt, retrieval, and structured response sizes across both collection cardinality and UTF-8 wire byte length so high-cardinality responses cannot exhaust context windows.

parameter_assignments.sc-05_odp.01: 32,768-byte structured payload cap with Pass 1 list-cardinality slicing and Pass 2 UTF-8 string truncation

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Execute torture test with >3,000 short items and oversized Unicode payloads; verify wire output stays <= 32 KiB.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Project upstream data responses down to explicit allowlisted high-signal fields, excluding unauthorized PII and raw catch-all dictionary dumps before LLM ingestion.

parameter_assignments.pt-02_odp.01: explicit x-mcp-fields projection allowlists with zero raw dict[str, Any] passthrough blobs

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Verify response schemas omit unapproved PII attributes and forbid unprojected catch-all maps.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Emit structured audit records capturing model/assistant invocation metadata, correlation IDs, and outcome status while redacting bearer tokens, API keys, and raw PII.

parameter_assignments.au-03_odp.01: stderr JSON audit records with correlation ID, tool/route name, latency, status, and credential redaction

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Inspect emitted logs under happy and error paths to confirm zero plaintext secrets or stdout pollution.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Continuously monitor generative assistant error rates, truncation frequency, and schema-validation rejections to detect prompt abuse or upstream contract drift.

parameter_assignments.ca-07_odp.01: continuous tracking of validation failures, payload-bounding triggers, and anomalous error spikes

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Verify telemetry surfaces truncation events and validation rejections per endpoint.
